global_geochemistry
====================

Codes for analyzing global geochemistry -- whole-rock geochemical data
processing, classification, and plotting for a global set of samples from a
variety of governmental and academic studies. Used by Laser Map Explorer
(*LaME*) for geochemistry plot utilities (e.g. radar/spider diagrams).
